STAGE 2: REGIME CLASSIFICATION & BENCHMARKING

Clearness Index (Kt) Regime Classifier
• Daily Clearness Ratio Calculation:
  Kt = ∑ POAdaylight / ∑ POAclear-sky across Blocks 24 to 76
• Classification Thresholds:
  − Kt < 0.50 → OVERCAST (Heavy cloud cover / monsoon)
  − 0.50 ≤ Kt < 0.75 → MIXED (Variable passing clouds)
  − Kt ≥ 0.75 → CLEAR (High uninhibited irradiance)

Exponential Decay & Regime-Matched Weighting
• Temporal Recency Weighting:
  wd = exp(−offset / τ) where τ = 3.5 days (Recent days matter most)
• Stratified Regime-Matching Multiplier:
  − If Evaluation Day Regime == Today's Regime: wd ← wd × 1.50
  − If Evaluation Day Regime != Today's Regime: wd ← wd × 0.65
• Ensures sunny historical days do not bias an overcast target day forecast

Asymmetric DSM Penalty Loss Formulation
• Statistical Metrics for Model Member k:
  RMSEpoa(k) = √( ∑ wd × (POAactual − POAmodel)² / ∑ wd )
  Biaspoa(k) = ∑ wd × (POAactual − POAmodel) / ∑ wd
  Corrpoa(k) = Pearson correlation of diurnal generation shape
• Shortfall Risk Penalty (Regulatory Shield):
  shortfall_risk = max(0.0, −raw_biaspoa) × 0.50
• Composite Objective Loss:
  Loss(k) = [ RMSEpoa + 0.40 × |Biaspoa| + shortfall_risk
                + 0.15 × (1.0 − Corrpoa) × 100.0 ] × Transfer_Ratio

STAGE 4: WEIGHTING, CALIBRATION & BLENDING

Bayesian Inverse-Loss Normalization
• Raw Inverse Weights:
  Wraw(k) = 1.0 / max(10−4, Composite_Loss(k))
• Normalized Bayesian Weight:
  W(k) = Wraw(k) / ∑ Wraw(j)
• High-accuracy models receive highest weight; inferior models smoothly attenuated

Empirical Diurnal MOS Linear Calibration Gain
• Linear Gain Formulation:
  αk = ∑ (POAactual × POAsim) / ∑ (POAsim)²
• Physical Stability Guardrail Clamp:
  αk = clip(αk, 0.85, 1.15)
• Directly removes systematic atmospheric agency under/over-estimation bias

Raised-Cosine Slot Cross-Fading (Blended Kt)
• Slot Clearness Calculation:
  Ktslot(b) = ∑ W(k) × clip( (αk × POAk) / max(15, POAcs), 0.0, 1.15 )
• Morning → Midday Transition (Blocks 39 to 42):
  γ = 0.5 × (1.0 − cos(π × (b − 38) / 4.0))
  Ktblended = max( (1 − γ) × Ktmorn + γ × Ktmid, 0.85 × Ktmorn )
• Midday → Afternoon Transition (Blocks 55 to 58):
  γ = 0.5 × (1.0 − cos(π × (b − 54) / 4.0))
  Ktblended = (1 − γ) × Ktmid + γ × Ktaft
• Eliminates boundary step-jumps and prevents artificial valley dips

Fused 96-Block GTI fused
GTIfused(b) = round(Ktblended(b) × POAcs(b), 1) [W/m²]

Why Direct Linear Interpolation Fails
Linear interpolation across 1-hour intervals creates sharp artificial triangles at sunrise, sunset, and solar noon, introducing catastrophic ramp rate errors in statutory 15-minute dispatch schedules.

Step A: Hourly Clearness Ratio kt(H)
For each hour H ∈ [0, 23]:
kt(H) = NWP_Forecast(H) / max(15.0, POAcs(H))
Normalizes out the astronomical solar curve; leaves pure cloud transmission

Step B: Smooth kt Spline to 15-Min Midpoints
kt(H) → Monotonic Spline → kt(b)
Because atmospheric cloud opacity changes slowly, kt interpolates smoothly without ringing or negative overshoots

Step C: Physics-Guided Reconstruction
Multiply by high-resolution instantaneous clear-sky POA:
GTImodel(b) = kt(b) × POAcs(b)
Preserves exact astronomical solar zenith & elevation geometry

Outcome: Natural Earth Rotation Curvature
• Smooth parabolic ramps at dawn and dusk
• Zero stepped or sawtooth interval artifacts
• Strictly bounded by POAcs astronomical maximum
• Formatted as 96-element vector per candidate member

143 × 96-Block Physical GTI Matrix
All 143 candidates discretized to statutory 15-minute grid
96 Block Base forecast based on weather ensemble

Convective Cell Temperature Derating (Faiman / Sandia Thermal Model)
Transforms 2m ambient weather temperature Tamb and wind speed W into actual PV module cell temperature:
Tcell(b) = Tamb(b) + GTI(b) / [ 25.0 + 1.2 × W(b) ]
temp_factor(b) = clip( 1.0 - 0.0038 × ( Tcell(b) - 25.0 ), 0.82, 1.06 )
Accounts for wind cooling and heat-induced solar panel voltage drop during summer/monsoon noon

Thermally-Corrected Clamped Base Generation Formula
Pbase(b) = clip( GTI(b) × transfer_ratio × temp_factor(b), 0.0, PAC,max )
Multiplies slot consensus GTI by calibrated transfer ratio and thermal factor; clamps strictly between 0.0 and PAC,max

2.1 INEICHEN CLEAR-SKY MODEL

Ineichen Clear-Sky Radiative Model
pvlib.clearsky.ineichen
Attenuates solar constant (I0 = 1361 W/m²) across atmosphere

Atmospheric Correction Parameters
• Site Altitude (z): Barometric pressure scaling
• Relative Air Mass (AM): Atmospheric path length
• Linke Turbidity (TL): Aerosols and water vapor

3-Component Radiative Decomposition
GHIcs:Global Horizontal Irradiance
DNIcs:Direct Normal Irradiance
DHIcs:Diffuse Horizontal Irradiance
GHIcs = DNIcs × cos(θz) + DHIcs

Horizontal Irradiance Triplet Vector
GHIcs, DNIcs, DHIcs ∈ ℝ96 [W/m²]
2.2 POA TRANSPOSITION (HAY-DAVIES / PEREZ)

Angle of Incidence (AOI) on Tilted Surface
cos(θ) = cos(θz) cos(β) + sin(θz) sin(β) cos(γs - γm)
• β = Panel Tilt Angle
• γm = 180.0° + orientation_deg_from_south

3 Plane-of-Array Irradiance Components
Direct Beam:POAbeam = DNIcs × max(0, cos θ)
Ground Albedo:POAground = GHIcs × 0.20 × (1 - cos β) / 2
Sky Diffuse:POAdiffuse = Hay-Davies anisotropic sky diffuse

Total Clear-Sky POA Irradiance Formula
POAcs(b) = POAbeam + POAdiffuse + POAground
If α(b) < 3.0° → POAcs(b) ≡ 0.00 W/m²

Astronomical Physics Reference Array
POAcs ∈ ℝ96 [W/m²]

PHASE 8: FOUR PHYSICAL GUARDRAILS & FINAL SCHEDULE COMPILATION

GUARDRAIL 1: Solar Geometry Hard Cutoff (Night Hours Zeroing)
• Rule: If Block b < 24 (Before 05:45 IST) OR Block b > 74 (After 18:30 IST):
  Pschedule(b) = 0.00 MW | GTI(b) = 0.0 W/m²
• Enforces zero generation during darkness regardless of model output.

GUARDRAIL 2: Clear-Sky Negative Cut Lockout (Floor Guarantee)
• Trigger: If Kt ≥ 0.85 OR Regime == "CLEAR_SKY" OR Cloud Cover ≤ 30%:
  If pred_mw < physics_base_mw → pred_mw = physics_base_mw
• Protects midday clear-sky output from artificial down-biasing.

GUARDRAIL 3: Overcast Optical Cloud Ceiling (Upper Ceiling Bound)
• Trigger: If Kt < 0.50 OR Regime in ("OVERCAST", "RAIN") OR Cloud Cover ≥ 75%:
  overcast_max = max( physics_base_mw × 1.10, PAC,max × 0.25 )
  If pred_mw > overcast_max → pred_mw = overcast_max
• Forbids over-predicting during monsoon fronts, stopping DSM shortfall penalties.

GUARDRAIL 4: Ramp-Rate Continuity Filter (Anti-Jump Smoothing)
• Max Ramp Step: max_ramp = max( 0.50 MW, PAC,max × 0.10 )
• Continuity Clamp: If | pred_mw − prev_val | > max_ramp → pred_mw = prev_val ± max_ramp
• Eliminates unrealistic step-discontinuities between consecutive blocks.
